messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty P1 -> service=inference-queue, symptom=rapid-queue-growth (>150k), severity=customer-impact. page fired to oncall rotation at 1767540000

 tom-oncall: ACK. I'm booting into the cluster now. pinging infra and eng.

 matt-eng: oncall noted. what's the current HPA status? any recent deploys?

 lena-infra: cloud reported 'capacityUnavailable' for preferred instance pool ~3m ago. autoscaler is still issuing scale requests but cloud returns 429/InsufficientCapacity.

 tom-oncall: checking k8s: many pods Pending in ns=inference-hot, node autoscaler unresponsive. kube-events show ImagePullBackOff on some older nodes.

 ops-bot: quick metrics: queue_length=153,410 -> inflow spike from /stream-generate, avg-rt 2.4s -> 4.9s, 95p up 2.3x. throughput tokens/s down 35%.

 zoe-sre: +1. also seeing control-plane backoff logs in autoscaler: "RateLimitExceeded: retryable". suspect exponential backoff combined with cloud quota hit.

 jordan-cs: CS reporting multiple enterprise sessions timed out; customers on chat integrations getting "504 gateway timeout". I'm drafting customer note.

 olivia-pm: tagging product for priority comms. Need exact affected routes and estimated downtime window.

 tom-oncall: immediate mitigations: 1) reduce weight on non-critical routes, 2) enable manual replica surge for hot workers, 3) provision fallback instance pool on different SKU. Executing now.

 tom-oncall: router change:
```
# reduce weight for background batch paths
curl -s -X POST https://router.internal/reweight -d '{"paths":["/batch-generate","/embeddings"],"factor":0.35}'
```

 tom-oncall: applied. inflow down ~30% after 25s.

 matt-eng: spawning manual surge for hot pool to keep short requests flowing:
```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/worker-hot --replicas=80
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/worker-warm --replicas=30
```

 tom-oncall: scale accepted. pods scheduling but many pending due to node shortage.

 lena-infra: provisioning fallback pool on different accounts/regions (temp) to bypass spot shortage. launching 10 c7-small now as emergency.

 deploy-bot: Launch request submitted: account=fallback-us-east2, sku=c7-small, count=10. cloud: provisioning in progress.

 ops-bot: note: kvcache misses increasing, prefix reuse down 28% — expect latency to remain elevated until cache warms.

 zoe-sre: suggest enabling kvcache soft-warm to avoid thundering herd once nodes come up. Applying env var to hot deployers.
```
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/worker-hot CACHE_PREWARM=1 CACHE_PREWARM_FACTOR=0.15
```

 jordan-cs: sent initial advisory to affected customers with retries guidance. CS will post updates when latency drops below 2s.

 tom-oncall: autoscaler logs snippet for timeline:
```
E 1767539940 autoscaler.go:512] ScaleRequest failed: 403 QuotaExceeded: requested 6 x p6-large
W 1767539990 autoscaler.go:527] Retrying scale after backoff=30s
```

 matt-eng: fallback instances are healthy; kubelet joined new nodes. scheduling pending pods now. first 20 pods moved to Running.

 ops-bot: metrics update: queue_length -> 62,120, avg-rt 2.6s, tokens/s recovering.

 tom-oncall: keeping manual replicas until autoscaler stabilizes. adding annotation to mark override until explicit removal:
```
kubectl annotate hpa/inference autoscaler.redwood/override="manual-surge-1767542000" --overwrite
```

 lena-infra: opened support ticket with cloud to request spot capacity increase and remove quota blocks. ETA for quota response ~24h, but immediate mitigation in place.

 olivia-pm: PM note for timeline: root cause appears to be simultaneous spot pool depletion + autoscaler backoff behavior. Impact: brief but noticeable customer timeouts on long-running generations and increased latency for high-throughput routes.

 jordan-cs: CS update: most customers report recovery; 4 customers still seeing retries. sending targeted follow-ups.

 tom-oncall: handing off to next oncall (matt) for full post-incident runbook + postmortem. leaving notes: commands executed, router reweight payload, manual scale commands, kube-annotate override, fallback instance pool ids, ticket# CLOUD-789.

 matt-eng: ACK takeover at 1767540450. I'll consolidate timeline, add follow-ups: (1) autoscaler retry policy review, (2) runbook for automatic fallback SKU pool, (3) add health check gating for router weight changes, (4) improve kvcache warmup strategy.

 incident-bot: PagerDuty note: acknowledged by tom-oncall at 1767540010, incident marked in-progress, initial mitigation applied.

 ops-bot: final metrics snapshot before handoff: queue_peak=153,410, current=45,900, peak-affected-sessions=38, pct_requests_delayed_>10s=6.2%.

 matt-eng: thanks all. will open incident report ticket and loop infra/autoscaler/tooling. leaving thread. :white_check_mark:
